easyPrerequisites: There are at least five total creatures on the battlefield.
description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Stag Beetle. Stag Beetle enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
Activate Stag Beetle using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
